from pathlib import Path
import json,os,stat,subprocess
ROOT=Path('/home/andre/lorcana-online-tcg')
def capture(args):
 r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Publication verification failed; credentials withheld')
 return r.stdout.strip()
branches=['codex/boot-01-foundation','codex/documentation-governance','codex/boot-02-database','codex/boot-03-ci','codex/boot-05-contracts']
remote=dict((ref,sha) for sha,ref in (line.split() for line in capture(['git','ls-remote','--heads','origin']).splitlines()))
head=capture(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']);assert capture(['git','branch','--show-current'])=='main';assert remote['refs/heads/main']==head
for branch in branches:
 sha=capture(['git','rev-parse',branch]);assert remote['refs/heads/'+branch]==sha
 capture(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',branch,'main'])
 print('PASS published ancestor',branch,sha)
print('PASS remote main equals merged local main',head)
private=[ROOT/'.env.local',ROOT/'.local/database.json'];before=[p.read_bytes() for p in private]
for p in private:
 assert not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600 and p.stat().st_uid==os.getuid()
 capture(['git','check-ignore','-q',str(p.relative_to(ROOT))])
assert stat.S_IMODE((ROOT/'.local').stat().st_mode)==0o700
project='lorcana-online-tcg_devcontainer';workspace=capture(['docker','ps','-q','--filter','label=com.docker.compose.project='+project,'--filter','label=com.docker.compose.service=workspace']);postgres=capture(['docker','ps','-q','--filter','label=com.docker.compose.project='+project,'--filter','label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres'])
assert workspace and postgres and capture(['docker','inspect','--format','{{.State.Health.Status}}',postgres])=='healthy'
ports=json.loads(capture(['docker','inspect','--format','{{json .NetworkSettings.Ports}}',postgres]));assert ports=={'5432/tcp':None}
mounts=json.loads(capture(['docker','inspect','--format','{{json .Mounts}}',postgres]));assert any(m['Name']==project+'_pg18_data' and m['Destination']=='/var/lib/postgresql' for m in mounts if m['Type']=='volume')
probe="const fs=require('node:fs');for(const path of ['/proc/net/tcp','/proc/net/tcp6'])for(const line of fs.readFileSync(path,'utf8').split('\\n').slice(1)){const f=line.trim().split(/\\s+/);if(f[3]==='0A'&&[5173,3001,3002].includes(parseInt(f[1].split(':').at(-1),16)))throw Error('Owned foundation listener remains');}console.log('PASS no owned foundation listeners5173/3001/3002');"
print(capture(['docker','exec','-u','node',workspace,'node','-e',probe]));assert before==[p.read_bytes() for p in private]
print('PASS original healthy private database/volume and owner-only ignored private files preserved')
print('Observed remote-main policy:',capture(['gh','api','repos/chroniicallydiistracted/lorcana-online-tcg/branches/main','--jq','{name,protected,sha:.commit.sha}']))
print('Observed hosted workflow state:',capture(['gh','run','list','--branch','main','--limit','5','--json','databaseId,headSha,status,conclusion,url,workflowName']))
print('Prior publication actions with their own captured UTC/exit/output, distinct from this read-only verification:')
print(Path('/tmp/lorcana-publication-events.json').read_text())
